title: Hydraulic shears
subtitle: Dener BS / BSY swing beam shears to 5/8″ · DAS CNC guillotine shears to 3/4″ × 20 ft
cover_line: Dener Makina · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Plate shears from a builder with 52 years behind it
about_text: Dener Makina has built sheet-metal machinery in Kayseri since 1974 — press brakes, shears, fiber lasers and panel benders exported to more than 100 countries, with its own design awards and offices in the USA, Canada, Germany and India. The shears in this catalogue are the two hydraulic lines: the BS / BSY swing beam shears, a simple, rugged plate shear from 1/4″ to 5/8″ over 6.8 to 13.5 ft with an NC back gauge and hydraulic hold-downs, and the DAS CNC guillotine shears, the production machine from 1/4″ to 3/4″ over 10 to 20 ft whose ESA 630 control sets the back gauge, blade gap and variable cutting angle from the thickness and material the operator keys in.

Both lines are built on welded steel frames rigid against torsion over the full length, with motorised ball-screw back gauges accurate to 0.1 mm, sheet slider tables, squaring arms and photocell front guards. NovoTech sells, installs and supports them in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts stocked in Canada.
